articles.title: How to Submit PTO Requests
articles.body:
Submitting a PTO Request

Navigate to HR Portal > Time Off > New Request. Fill in the dates, select the type (Full Day or Half Day), and submit. Your manager will receive an email notification.

Half-day requests must specify AM or PM. All requests require 48 hours advance notice.

articles.title: Expense Report Approval Workflow
articles.body:
Expense Approval Process

Submit expense reports through the Finance portal. Reports under $500 are auto-approved. Reports over $500 require manager + Finance team approval.

Attach all receipts as PDF. Processing takes 5-7 business days after final approval.

articles.title: Software and System Access Requests
articles.body:
Requesting Application Access

All software access requests must go through the IT Portal. Select the application, choose permission level, and add your line manager as approver.

Provisioning SLA: 2 business days for standard applications, 5 days for privileged access.
